about: Amoxliatl (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Amoxliatl), as captured in her chamber beneath the Ruins of Tapoyauik (rsprox captures 1147 and 1695): the door, the instance, the fight and the kill. Tiles are absolute, on the cache map; the instance copies them. See docs/amoxliatl.md.

door.about: vmq3_ruins_door_multi: the Frozen door until The Heart of Darkness is done (varbit 11117), then 'Door' with Pass-through.

instance.about: As captured: the whole of map square 5446 (8x8 chunks), plane 0, unturned.

exits.question: Are you sure you want to exit?

fade.about: As captured, in and out alike: the fade out, the minimap off a tick later, the move at 2, the fade back in at 4 and the overlay closed at 6.

spawn.about: Respawn ticks are counted from the kill-count message (R1140).
spawn.say: Euat! You are not welcome here!

arena.about: The platform her spikes cover (every tile they were seen on), as rows of [y, minX, maxX], and the 3-wide path east to the ice blockage. Its centre plays the pools' sound.

spikes.about: Map animations on tiles around the player, as captured: the player's own tile about 3 in 4, the tiles next to it about 2 in 3, the rest out to 6 about 1 in 4. 3 ticks after the attack they come up and hit a player still on one, as her hit: 6-16 (R1140: over 90 spike hits, every value from 6 to 16).

pools.about: An icy pool on the player's tile 3 ticks after each standard attack (captured); standing on one deals 6-10 a tick (Wiki; R1140's pool hits are 6-10), each with sound 4464 (R1140). They stay until she dies, then go with a puff (captured).

specials.about: After every 2-4 standard attacks a special; the first at random, then in turn (Wiki). From the path she only has room for Icicle Crash. Her next attack comes 9 ticks after Icicle Crash and 7 after Unstable Ice (R1140: 38 of 38 and 40 of 40; R1695 the same).

icicle.about: Projectile heights here are the engine's: R1140 sends startheight 448 on the wire, which PacketSender.sendProjectile makes from 112 (x4), as for Unstable Ice.
icicle.message: <col=ff3045>Amoxliatl disables your prayers and launches an icicle attack!</col>

unstableIce.message: <col=00ffff>Amoxliatl forms some unstable ice blocks around you.

postQuest.message: <col=00e6e6>Amoxliatl forms some unstable ice blocks around you.

questEnd.about: The quest's guardian doesn't die (R1140 ticks 7686-7693, R1695 4926-4934): at 0 HP she becomes 13687 with 11531 and 'Zema ami miki!', her pools go, and she throws one last icicle at the player; 3 ticks later the player's teleport (4018, 2754) and her death (11532), the sound and the HP HUD going (hpbar_hud_npc -1) a tick after, and the player is out 6 ticks after the 0 HP. The quest varbit moves on (72 to 74) and the player is held on the 0 HP tick; a logout before the teleport is saved at `outside`, where the quest lands the player (R1140 tick 7692).

kill.about: As captured: the pools go on the killing blow; 2 ticks later (deathTicks) the kill count, the fight's length and the loot on her middle tile.

respawnLines.about: As captured (R1140, normal and Echo alike): every rise after the first in a visit says one of these; the first says spawn.say.
lines: Euat! We are not done yet!
Euat! I am not so easily destroyed!
Euat! This is not yet over!

echo.about: The Leagues VI Echo (rsprox.net 1140, rev 237.1: 7 Echoes, 6 kills). Ticks count from her turn (A). Ids are gameval names. Projectile heights are as recorded on the wire (4x the engine's).

turns.about: Her turns run on the fight's own clock: the first 4 ticks after she rises, then every 4; the turn after a phase cast 5 ticks later; in the enrage every 2.

phases.about: Decided on a turn, on her hitpoints after that tick's damage. Recorded: the first cast at 476-516, never at 538 or more (the Wiki says 500); the second at 220-250, never at 262 or more (the Wiki's 250).

standard.about: Her turn below the enrage: two magic shots that land 3 and 4 ticks later (Protect from Magic blocks them: 160 of 160), and the black icicle the next tick at the tile the player stood on.

shot.maxHitAbout: Recorded unprayed: 0, 0, 2, 3, 6, 8, 10, 24, 27 and 30 (10 shots). The Wiki's 93 doesn't fit.

enrage.about: From the second phase cast: no magic shots, only the icicle, every 2 ticks.

icicle.about: Sent the tick after her turn from her middle tile to where the player stood on her turn; lands 2 ticks later. A player on its tile or the spikes at the end of the tick before takes 18-26 (stepping off on the landing tick is too late: 19 of 19), through Protect from Magic; a player who isn't hit hears it shatter.

spikes.about: As it lands: its tile and every floor tile 2-4 steps from it, but not the 8 around it (the Wiki's safe tiles), each delayed 2 cycles a step.

phase.about: A phase cast in place of a turn: the spikes on every floor tile within 2 steps of the player at once, prayers turned off the next tick, and 3 ticks later the hit (as the icicle's) and a pool on each tile.

pools.about: An icy pool where each icicle lands and on each phase tile, unless one is there. A pool hurts from its second tick: 7-15 to a player on it (10 recorded). It goes after 100 ticks (4 recorded) or with her, with a puff.
